question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

An unexpected power failure which __happened besides the recording__ disheartened all of them.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase **"which happened besides the recording"** is incorrect because** "besides"** implies "in addition to" which doesn't make sense in this context.
